# BoardingEdu

> BoardingEdu helps families find, compare, and enquire with day and boarding schools across India, then request free admission counselling.

Site: https://boardingedu.com
Contact: hello@boardingedu.com

## Main pages
- Home: https://boardingedu.com/
- School directory: https://boardingedu.com/schools
- Compare schools: https://boardingedu.com/compare

## URL patterns
- Location listings: /{country}/{state}/{city}/day-school
- Residential listings: /{country}/{state}/residential-school
- Education boards: /board/{board-slug}
- School profiles: /{country}/{state}/{city}/{optional-locality}/{school-slug}

Do not treat login or signup pages as public documentation.
